overview: The Medford Happenings team reviewed their inaugural year of 31 episodes and 14,000 views before announcing a holiday hiatus. The broadcast focused on recognizing contributors and outlining expansion plans for 2026, including invitations to city officials.

items.title: Year-in-Review and Contributor Recognition
items.summary: John Petrella reflected on the program's growth over the past year and thanked core team members Paul Geraghty, Bruce Patterson, and Marco Cronali.

items.title: Support and Media Partnerships
items.summary: The host acknowledged the technical support from Medford Community Media staff and highlighted successful collaborations with the online publication 'Get to Know Medford.'

items.title: Holiday Hiatus and 2026 Programming Goals
items.summary: Petrella announced a production break until the new year and stated intentions to feature the Mayor, City Council, and School Committee in future episodes.

items.title: Call for Volunteers
items.summary: The production team requested additional volunteers to help manage the workload of producing the show in the upcoming season.

items.title: Team Holiday Greetings
items.summary: The core production team delivered individual messages of holiday well-wishes to the viewers to conclude the year.

subject: Medford Happenings Year-in-Review
